summary: Iteration 10 verifies the live-status-propagation / focus-refetch / cross-tab session-switch fix (index.js QueryClient defaults + AuthProvider revalidate). Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_department_routing.py — 1/1 passed (a fresh citizen POST /api/applications for MH_POST_MATRIC_SCHOLARSHIP with district Pune reaches UNDER_REVIEW; the resulting transaction appears in GET /api/reviews?state=pending for sjsa@demo.in and is absent from official@demo.in and agri@demo.in inboxes). Frontend Playwright covered every requested scenario end-to-end using Playwright browser contexts to simulate separate cookie jars/tabs. (FIX 1) Context A citizen@demo.in on /citizen with a freshly created drip-irrigation application; Context C operator@demo.in opened /operations/transactions BEFORE the sanction; Context B agri@demo.in filled review-remarks and clicked review-sanction. WITHOUT reloading, Context A row-status-<APPID> flipped from 'Under department review' to 'Completed' in ~3.2 s and progress-<APPID> read '✓✓✓✓' (4 dots). Context C operator row also flipped to Completed within the 10 s window. Citizen detail /citizen/applications/<APPID>: transaction-status='Completed', review-outcome-title='Sanctioned by the department', review-outcome-officer contains 'Sunita Jadhav · District Superintending Agriculture Officer', completion-banner contains '₹40,000'. /citizen/notifications lists 'Review Decided' and 'Application Completed' entries (see minor note below re: 'Application Approved' wording). (FIX 1b) In an isolated Context A, listened to page.on('request'), created a pending application, then emulated a hidden tab (Object.defineProperty(document,'visibilityState','hidden') + visibilitychange), sanctioned the case from Context B, and restored visibilityState='visible' + dispatched visibilitychange & window 'focus'. Two GET /api/applications requests fired within 70 ms of the focus event and two GET /api/auth/me requests also fired; row-status-<APPID> switched to 'Completed' within 1.5 s of focus. Confirms AuthProvider.revalidate + queryClient.invalidateQueries wire up correctly. (FIX 2) Same browser context, page A signed in as citizen@demo.in via UI; page B (same context) logout-button → login-page → demo-official-select → officer-agriculture → login-submit-button → lands on /operations/reviews. Focused page A and dispatched window 'focus' — within ~1 s the URL changed to /operations/reviews (correct role-guard redirect), current-user rendered 'Sunita Jadhav · District Superintending Agriculture Officer', and the sonner toast text read exactly 'Signed in as Sunita Jadhav from another tab · switching workspace'. No 'session expired' toast, no blank screen. (REGRESSION – logout) Fresh operator context, tab A and tab B on /operations, tab B clicks logout-button → /login. On focus event, tab A redirected to /login (401 path) with zero pageerror events. (REGRESSION – single-tab operator navigation) Overview → nav-transactions → transactions list shows application-count='118 transactions' → open a transaction → transaction-status='Completed' → back to list → application-count still populated; no React Query errors or runtime pageerrors emitted throughout navigation. Existing regressions kept green: /app/backend/tests/test_review_flow.py (12 tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_multi_scheme.py (14+1 skip) unchanged.

integration_issues.issue: The review-request expects three notification titles: 'Review Decided', 'Application Approved', 'Application Completed'. Observed on /citizen/notifications after a successful sanction: 'Review Decided' ✓ and 'Application Completed' ✓ are present, but 'Application Approved' is NOT emitted as a distinct entry. This appears to be intentional (Review Decided is the approval event) but review request wording implies three separate items. Non-blocking; either update the copy expectation or add a distinct 'Application Approved' notification alongside 'Review Decided'.

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether a distinct 'Application Approved' notification (in addition to 'Review Decided' + 'Application Completed') should be emitted after officer sanction — currently only 2 of the 3 titles listed in the review request appear on /citizen/notifications.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthProvider.revalidate correctly guards on document.visibilityState==='hidden' and userRef.current, avoiding a login-time race. Consider debouncing rapid focus/visibilitychange bursts (e.g. when a modal toggles document.hidden repeatedly) — currently every focus fires two GETs (applications + auth/me observed at +0.07 s together). Not a bug, but worth a small guard if this endpoint gets more expensive.

The sonner toast in FIX 2 appeared twice in the DOM ('Signed in as Sunita Jadhav from another tab · switching workspace | Signed in as Sunita Jadhav from another tab · switching workspace'). The toast id 'session-switched' should dedupe, but React 19 StrictMode double-invoked the useEffect during dev. Sonner will still show one visible toast because of the id, but confirm behavior in production build. Non-blocking.

index.js queries.staleTime=0 means every mount refetches — combined with route-level refetchInterval this is fine for a demo but doubles cold-start requests for background tabs on unstable networks; consider staleTime≈2s to coalesce.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (FIX 1, FIX 1b, FIX 2, logout regression, single-tab regression)

test_credentials: citizen@demo.in / operator@demo.in / agri@demo.in (Sunita Jadhav) / sjsa@demo.in / official@demo.in — Demo@2026!
seed_data_creation: Playwright + pytest created ~3 real citizen applications during this run (2× MH_DRIP_IRRIGATION_SUBSIDY sanctioned to COMPLETED, 1× MH_POST_MATRIC_SCHOLARSHIP left UNDER_REVIEW after routing assertion). Operator transactions count went from 116→118 during single-tab regression. No seed reset performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All fix scenarios pass. Reusable script pattern: use browser.new_context() to create separate cookie jars for cross-session tests; ctx.request for cookie-scoped API calls with X-CSRF-Token from ctx.cookies(). For focus/visibility tests, dispatch document 'visibilitychange' AND window 'focus' — AuthProvider listens to both. Only outstanding cosmetic decision is the missing 'Application Approved' notification title (see integration_issues).
rca of the issue: Original bug (approval not reflecting in citizen/operator transactions views without reload) was caused by (1) React Query staleTime=60s + refetchOnWindowFocus=false and (2) shared session cookies across tabs. Fix in /app/frontend/src/index.js (staleTime 0, refetchOnWindowFocus/Reconnect true) + AuthProvider.revalidate on focus/visibilitychange (invalidates queries or switches user+clears cache when /auth/me id changes) resolves both. Verified: (a) focus fires GET /api/applications within 70 ms and updates row in ≤1.5 s; (b) cross-tab session switch shows toast + redirects; (c) 401 interceptor still handles the logout-elsewhere case, redirecting stale tabs to /login.
